test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Non-functional dimensions are _______________.

options.text: directly derived from the values given on a drawing
essential for the function of the space or component
derived from the values of the related features of a drawing
not essential for the function of the space or component

solution:
The correct answer is __not essential for the function of the space or component.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Non-functional dimensions__ are dimensions that are not crucial for the operation or functionality of a space or component.
 
• These dimensions are provided for informational purposes or to ensure proper fitment or aesthetic alignment.
 
• They do not directly influence the performance or usability of the design.
 
• Such dimensions can be derived from other related dimensions on the drawing.
 
• Non-functional dimensions are often used as supplementary details in technical drawings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Functional Dimensions:**

 
 
• These are critical dimensions that define the functionality or performance of a space or component.
 
• They must be precise and are directly derived from design requirements.
 
 
 
• **Derived Dimensions:**
 
 
• Derived dimensions are calculated from other known dimensions in the drawing.
 
• These are generally provided for clarity or to assist in manufacturing and assembly.
